about: The 3D view's bundled HDRI environments (#175): CC0 1k .hdr files from Poly Haven, fetched by packages/specto-web/build.py (pinned by sha256) and prefiltered at build time into web/vendor/hdri/<name>.env (Babylon's prefiltered cube, cube_size per face). Nothing is fetched at runtime.
